body:
Parent: #1715
Depends on: #2158, #2159, #2160, #1712, #1713, #1707, #1709, #1710

## 原子目标

通过#2159评论结构端口与#2160审核端口建立#1715唯一transaction-fixture producer，按profile/capability plan生成独立thread/version/delete/moderation/region/signal/evidence矩阵并验证public/admin/queue/cache postconditions。Producer只做现有ports编排与普通receipt，不保留demo correctness数据、direct SQL、legacy actor或旧helpers。

## 必须交付

1. Producer exact-one由#1709DAG调用，输入绑定run/namespace/profile/comment capabilities、#1712 article refs、#1713 actor/admin refs、#2158 inventory/catalog/temporal/producer plan digests；profile未要求comment capability时零执行。
2. Thread/reply/depth/edited/soft-delete facts只通过#2159；moderation/region/signal/evidence/queue facts只通过#2160，不复制domain logic。
3. Comments-moderation profile至少生成父issue完整矩阵：approved root+reply+second-level reply、pending、rejected/spam、edited、soft-deleted root/reply、depth boundary与超界negative plan、至少两种region/policy/evidence状态。
4. 每个互斥state使用独立semantic comment identity；不得同一comment顺序update后只记录最终快照。
5. Actor modes只使用canonical `public`与`zk_anonymous`，禁止legacy/demo/compat actor。
6. Producer只消费article/auth refs，不创建/修改article、identity、admin permission、security risk或messages data。
7. DB/thread/version/moderation/evidence/public/admin/queue/cache facts由同一operation plan与recovery boundary协调；任一partial/mismatch不发布verified receipt。
8. Rerun/idempotency只验证或重建exact owned comments/evidence，不累计duplicate thread/version/audit/outbox或删除其他profiles。
9. Verified receipt记录semantic roles、comment/article/actor identities、thread/depth/version/delete/moderation/reason/region/signal/evidence/queue/public-admin/cache refs与content digest，不记录private actor credential/evidence payload。
10. Independent verifier逐capability调用#2159/#2160verifiers，要求relations、history、visibility、queue membership、cache generation与policy evidence全部通过。
11. Failure/cancel/timeout输出exact owned cleanup/recovery receipt，不warning-and-continue、direct cleanup scan或切换strategy。
12. Entity IDs/roles只从verified receipt投影，禁止first pending/first row/title/demo/environment discovery。
13. Static governance禁止direct comment SQL、legacy actor、same-comment all states、queue-count pass、producer cross-domain creation与second producer。

## 固定约束

- 不实现thread/moderation ports或legacy removal。
- 不修改product comment/moderation policies/actor modes。
- 不迁移comment consumers，已归#1719/#2049。
- 不消费demo-public comments为correctness。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- full matrix正向；
- profile none still creates comments；
- partial thread/moderation/cache still verified；
- same comment all states；
- legacy/demo actor；
- producer creates article/admin/security data；
- first-pending/environment discovery；
- queue count >0；
- rerun duplicates；
- nonowned cleanup；
- public/admin/queue disagreement；
- receipt leaks private evidence；
- direct SQL/second producer。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Comment/moderation capabilities由一个producer owner通过两个port families生成。
- [ ] 完整thread/version/delete/moderation/region/evidence矩阵使用独立entities。
- [ ] Article/auth/security ownership边界不越权，profile none零执行。
- [ ] Public/admin/queue/cache/postconditions exact且partial不能verified。
- [ ] 本PR不删除legacy paths或修改产品语义。

## 非目标

- 不实现ports/inventory。
- 不删除demo/legacy/direct-SQL paths，归#2162。
- 不迁移consumers。
- 不测试完整moderation UI flow。

comments.body:
Closed via #3485 (squash 392c3bd005f3e0c3690c066153ff960972dddfd0), stacked on merged #3484.

Acceptance evidence:
- Single comment-moderation producer orchestrates the #2159 thread port and #2160 moderation port only; seeder no longer touches IModerationRuntimeStateService or the cache probe directly.
- Full thread/version/delete/moderation/region/signal/evidence matrix uses independent comment identities (plan rejects reused ids/roles); canonical public + zk_anonymous actor modes only.
- Cross-domain sentinels (article/auth/admin/security digests) verified unchanged before/after prepare and cleanup; profile without comment capability is a no-op.
- Public/admin/queue/cache postconditions exact; capabilityProofs require all-exact; partial results cannot publish verified.
- Cleanup returns fsusblog.comment-fixture-cleanup-result.v1 with the moderation cleanup observation; re-run cleanup is idempotent.
- Real Docker PostgreSQL+Redis lane post-rebase (comments-moderation, run issue-2161-verify-r2 at d13ca39): verified receipt sha256:54a4116c07529bda8a51ecd469130755e6a770729dcb6ffe31e7412da93e7a9d; cleanup cleaned.
- Depends-on #2158/#2159/#2160/#1712/#1713/#1707/#1709/#1710 all CLOSED.

Residual environment note: frontend-inclusive acceptance bootstrap is environment-blocked (cmake 4.4.1 vs pinned 4.3.3); evidence above is real PostgreSQL/Redis.
